chunks: ‘Alī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ismā‘īl ibn Murrār, from Yūnus, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ‘Abd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a woman whom a man married, then he found that she already had a husband. He said: “Upon him is flogging, and upon her is stoning, because he had proceeded with knowledge, and she had proceeded with knowledge. And his expiation, if he is not brought before the Imam, is that he should give in charity five sā‘s of flour.”

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam as the lawful authority before whom the case is presented
key_terms.بِعِلْمٍ: with knowledge and awareness of the situation
key_terms.زَوْجًا: a husband already belonging to her

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man knowingly marries a woman who already has a husband?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who marries a woman and it is discovered that she already has a husband, while both parties acted knowingly. It specifies the hadd punishments for each and mentions a kaffarah for the man if the case is not brought before the Imam.
